plain: In 1976, when jets of the Shah's air force chased an unknown object over Tehran, Iran, a US military satellite may have picked up something unusual too. A researcher who is a guest on the show says two aerospace researchers, Lee Graham and Ron Regehr, claimed they had studied printouts from the Defense Support Program, American satellites that watch for heat from space, for the exact day and time of the chase. If so, the encounter would have been recorded by a machine as well as by the pilots.
